title: A plain Export with the list `en`
exercises: LP-110: outside the language modes the constructor only runs the installed-language check, and `en` is checked like any other code. The export itself is the plain one.
note: Recorded while dev had the Language `en` only. With a second Language the `*` expands to its code and the same item is exported with translations: see the `lang-*` cases (seeded and cleaned up by `oracle:export-scratch-cases`).
